breakdown.description: Inviscid (zero viscosity) is incompatible with diffusion flame which relies on viscous/diffusive transport. The simulation must use sutherland transport, not zero viscosity.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification retains the line 'Set viscosity = 0 everywhere to represent an inviscid flame,' directly repeating the original error. The ground truth explicitly removes this instruction and notes that Sutherland transport must be used (not zero viscosity) because a diffusion flame requires viscous/diffusive transport. The agent failed to identify and fix this inconsistency.
